title: Recursion and happy-strings exercise sheet with ChatGPT
summary: First-year students individually complete a two-week exercise sheet using free ChatGPT-3.5. They interpret four recursive snippets, implement a more difficult happy-strings algorithm, and submit every prompt and response alongside their work; correct submissions can improve the exam grade.

sources.title: How Novice Programmers Use and Experience ChatGPT when Solving Programming Exercises in an Introductory Course
sources.evidence_quote: Students were instructed to complete the tasks using ChatGPT via the free version and to submit all prompts and responses

assessment.summary: Interpret recursive code and implement happy-string functions while using ChatGPT-3.5 and recording the complete interaction.
student_actions: Determine outputs, call counts, and recursion types for four snippets.
Implement checks for happy strings and their substrings.
Use ChatGPT-3.5 for support and submit all prompts and responses.

outputs.artifact: Spreadsheet of all ChatGPT prompts and responses

student_role.description: Use of free ChatGPT-3.5 is required, but students receive only a link to a prompting guide rather than task-specific prompting instructions.

grading.method: Correct submissions earn points that can improve the examination grade.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
